purpose: Measure the evidence the PRODUCTION /ask pipeline actually hands to the language model (frozen protocol item P1). The bm25_v1.0 benchmark scored the raw BM25 ranking; production additionally applies a coverage gate, a relative-score cutoff, top_k = 6, 25 s context padding, merging into passages, chronological order, a prompt-token budget, and sends short transcripts whole.

what_is_run.code_path: qa.service.AskService.answer (unmodified), which calls qa.retrieval.select_evidence; the plan it builds is captured by wrapping qa.service.select_evidence at run time (nothing is edited on disk)
what_is_run.language_model: NONE is called. A local recording stand-in provider replaces Gemini, so no network and no API key are used; it only counts how many times the model would have been called.
what_is_run.ask_config: AskConfig.from_env() with every ASK_* environment variable unset, i.e. the code defaults: max_prompt_tokens 4000, full_transcript_max_tokens 2000, chars_per_token 3.5. The run aborts if any ASK_* variable is set.
what_is_run.current_time: None (benchmark questions carry no playback position)
what_is_run.transcript: qa.transcript.normalize_segments over the dataset field "text", as in bm25_v1.0; one lecture per question
what_is_run.evidence: the union of the passage blocks in the final EvidencePlan of that question (the text the model would be sent); a question with a failed gate has empty evidence

question_sets.headline: PRIMARY_ANSWERABLE (133)
question_sets.descriptive_gate_behaviour_only: PRIMARY_UNANSWERABLE (43) and SENSITIVITY_UNANSWERABLE (7): counts of gate decisions / modes / model calls; NOT an abstention evaluation (A1 stays deferred)

relevance: identical to bm25_v1.0: an evidence passage is relevant by the cue IDs it contains; gold cue sets come from the same gold intervals with preprocessing-dropped cues removed

metrics.evidence_hit: 1 if the evidence contains at least one gold cue of any gold interval, else 0 (HEADLINE; the production counterpart of Hit Rate@k)
metrics.interval_coverage: fraction of the question's gold intervals having at least one cue in the evidence (counterpart of Interval Recall@k)
metrics.full_interval_coverage: 1 if EVERY gold interval has at least one cue in the evidence (counterpart of Full-evidence coverage@k) (HEADLINE)
metrics.strict_containment: 1 if EVERY retrievable gold cue of every interval is in the evidence (stricter than the benchmark metrics; the whole gold passage reaches the model)
metrics.gold_cue_fraction: share of the retrievable gold cues present in the evidence (descriptive)
metrics.gate_failure: 1 if select_evidence returned no usable evidence (the model is never called and the student gets the "couldn't find it" reply)
metrics.cost_descriptives: estimated prompt tokens, evidence characters, number of passages, share of the transcript sent, evidence mode (full / retrieval / time / summary / playback), model called yes/no
metrics.raw_comparison: raw BM25 Hit@5 and Hit@6 per question from the frozen ranking (top_k in production is 6); Hit@5 must equal the saved bm25_v1.0 per-question values

statistics.interval: question-level percentile bootstrap, 95%, B = 10000, seed 20261013, random.Random, nearest-rank 250th/9750th (same function as bm25_v1.0)
statistics.secondary: lecture-clustered bootstrap for the headline metrics (same function as bm25_v1.0)
statistics.small_samples: n < 10: point estimate only; n < 30: interval with instability warning
statistics.strata: evidence mode, subject, question category (PRIMARY_ANSWERABLE only), descriptive
statistics.paired_comparison: per-question difference evidence_hit minus raw BM25 Hit@5 (and Hit@6), paired bootstrap interval, DESCRIPTIVE: no decision rule is registered for this comparison
statistics.multiplicity: none applied; only evidence_hit and full_interval_coverage are headline

determinism: two independent runs (separate processes) must give byte-identical per-question results; otherwise no aggregate is written
abort_conditions: any frozen or registered hash mismatch
raw BM25 Hit@5 differs from the saved bm25_v1.0 per-question values
the stand-in provider is asked for a network call
no_tuning: Production code, thresholds and prompts are measured as they are. Nothing is changed in response to the results; any later change needs a new registered version.
interpreter: C:\Users\PMLS\miniconda3\python.exe (Python 3.11.5); the Python version differs from the one used for bm25_v1.0 (3.13.1), so the raw BM25 per-question values are cross-checked against the saved file

frozen_inputs.note: qa/retrieval.py, qa/transcript.py and qa/__init__.py are also pinned inside the frozen config. qa/service.py differs from the version in the earlier experiments: its "not found" message and its visual rule (6) were edited on 2026-10-14 (neither affects evidence selection); its hash is recorded here.
frozen_inputs.dataset_and_manifest_pins: verified through the frozen config's own pin list (14 hashes)

limitations: Labels are machine-drafted; only 1 of 176 primary questions is video-checked.
Evidence containing the gold passage is necessary, not sufficient, for a correct answer: answer quality is not measured here.
No playback position or attached moment is supplied, unlike a student using the app mid-lecture.
Whole-transcript mode (short lectures) makes evidence_hit trivially 1 for those lectures; strata by mode make this visible.
A passage containing a gold cue is counted relevant even when the cue is a minor part of it.
